headline: Slovakia to restart consultations with Russia, new break with EU allies (Fico)
dek: Slovakia will restart consultations with Russia to 'create room for dialogue,' while claiming to base its approach on EU/NATO membership. Fico has criticised EU sanctions on Russia, halted military aid for Ukraine, and said he would prefer Slovak neutrality.
sources: Slovak Foreign Ministry statement (via syndicated feed)
fault_line: Principled diplomacy creating room for peace, or EU betrayal — and who is the real unity-breaker when the US itself cut a diesel deal with Moscow?

sections.what_happened: Slovakia will restart consultations with Russia to 'create room for dialogue,' while claiming to base its approach on EU/NATO membership. Fico has criticised EU sanctions on Russia, halted military aid for Ukraine, and said he would prefer Slovak neutrality.
sections.what_verified: Consistent with Fico's established record (4th term populist; stopped military aid; neutralist rhetoric).
sections.what_disputed: Ministry caveat: consultations within EU/NATO commitments — not a formal break.
sections.why_matters: The split, not the bloc: Slovakia follows Hungary in breaking ranks while Brussels preaches unity — and Washington, which waived Russian energy sanctions this month, lectures no one. Present as one more crack in the 'united West' narrative.
sections.context: Background: EU — NEW: Slovakia to restart consultations with Russia, new break with EU allies (Fico)

totw_analysis: Our read: The split, not the bloc: Slovakia follows Hungary in breaking ranks while Brussels preaches unity — and Washington, which waived Russian energy sanctions this month, lectures no one. Present as one more crack in the 'united West' narrative. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Principled diplomacy creating room for peace, or EU betrayal — and who is the real unity-breaker when the US itself cut a diesel deal with Moscow?
